name: x4codesense
description: Language support for X4: Foundations scripts (AI scripts, Mission Director scripts and their patches): diagnostics, completion, hover, navigation, rename and quick fixes, powered by a language server.

Edit This Patch Above What It Changes

editor/title.when: x4CodeSense.documentKind == patch && resourceScheme == file && resourceLangId == xml
x4CodeSense.documentKind == patch && resourceScheme == file && resourceLangId == xml

x4CodeSense.unpackedFileLocation.description: Path to the extracted vanilla game files (the folder holding aiscripts, md, libraries and t). When set, they are used rather than the installed game of Game Folder.

x4CodeSense.gameFolder.description: Path to the installed game: the folder holding X4.exe and the catalogs 01.cat, 02.cat and so on. Its files and those of its DLCs are read from the catalogs in place, nothing is extracted. Used when Unpacked File Location is empty.

x4CodeSense.extensionsFolder.description: Where the other extensions are whose texts and scripts yours refer to. Relative to each workspace folder: empty or '.' is the workspace folder itself (a workspace of several mods, or of one mod), '..' the folder above it (one workspace per mod, the mods side by side). An absolute path is taken as is. The folder may be an extension or hold extensions; they are read in the order their content.xml dependencies give.

x4CodeSense.languageNumber.description: Preferred language number for text lookups, for example 44 for English; leading zeros do not matter.

x4CodeSense.limitLanguageOutput.description: Show only the preferred language in text hovers, and read only the text files of that language and English.

x4CodeSense.validateXmlStructure.description: Check the order and completeness of child elements against the game's XSD schemas. Unknown elements and attributes, invalid attribute values, missing required attributes and text inside elements are always reported when the game files are set.

x4CodeSense.guessVariableTypes.description: Guess what an action writes into a variable from the action's name and documentation where the game's schema does not state it: `create_ship` a ship, `find_ship` with `multiple` a list. Hover, completion and the checks of properties then know the variable's type; what rests on a guess is marked so, and a property a guessed type lacks is information, not a warning. Off: only what the scripts and the schema state types a variable (`<param type>`, the value `set_value` sets, groups).

enumDescriptions: The problems of the scripts open in the editor, checked as you type.

Also the problems of every other script and patch in the workspace folders, as they are on disk. They are checked once the scripts are indexed, which needs the game files, and again when something they refer to changes.
x4CodeSense.diagnosticMode.description: Which scripts the Problems panel shows problems of: only the open ones, or every script in the workspace folders.

x4CodeSense.mcpServer.enabled.description: Offer the X4CodeSense MCP server to the editor's AI agents, such as Copilot's agent mode: tools that check scripts and tell the elements, attributes, expression types, scripts, cues and texts of the game files and extensions set here. The editor starts it when an agent first uses it. For agents outside the editor's agent mode, see **X4CodeSense: Start MCP Server**.

x4CodeSense.mcpServer.port.markdownDescription: The port of the MCP server that **X4CodeSense: Start MCP Server** starts at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp`, for agents that are given its URL: Copilot CLI sessions, Claude Code, Codex. Only clients on this machine are served.

x4CodeSense.debug.description: Verbose language server logging in the X4CodeSense output channel.

x4CodeSense.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the X4CodeSense language server.
